title: Life cycle of a butterfly
examples: What is the first thing a butterfly starts as?
What does the caterpillar do before it becomes a butterfly?
How long does the chrysalis stage last?

explain.say: Look at this picture. A butterfly starts its life as a tiny egg.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: the life cycle of a butterfly. Can you see the eggs and the caterpillar? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Next, the egg hatches into a hungry caterpillar. This stage is all about eating.
When the caterpillar is big enough, it makes a chrysalis. This is a resting case.
Finally, the chrysalis opens, and a beautiful butterfly emerges. It dries its wings slowly.

A common mistake is thinking the butterfly just grows bigger like a caterpillar. Remember, the caterpillar must change completely inside its case. This amazing change is called metamorphosis, which is very special.

faq.q: Does the caterpillar eat all the time?
faq.a: Yes, the caterpillar eats almost constantly to get energy for growing. It needs many leaves to get big enough.
Yes, the butterfly is changing inside the chrysalis. It is reorganizing its body parts completely.

faq.q: How long does the whole cycle take?
faq.a: The time can change depending on the weather and the species. Some parts take much longer than others.

faq.q: Does the butterfly lay eggs on its own kind?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Butterflies tend to lay their eggs on the specific type of plant that their caterpillars will like to eat.

faq.q: What is the difference between a chrysalis and a cocoon?
faq.a: A chrysalis is the hard case of a butterfly. A cocoon is usually spun by moths and is made of silk.

facts: Metamorphosis means a big change in life.
The caterpillar's main job is to eat and grow.
The chrysalis protects the change happening inside.

quiz.say: What stage comes right after the caterpillar eats enough?
quiz.why: The caterpillar must form a chrysalis to begin the process of changing into a butterfly.

wrong.1: The egg is the very first stage, not the next one.
wrong.2: The butterfly is the final stage, not the one that comes next.
wrong.3: A leaf is what the caterpillar eats, not a life stage.

quiz.say: If you see a butterfly, what stage did it just come from?
quiz.why: The butterfly emerges from the protective casing called the chrysalis.

wrong.0: The caterpillar comes before the chrysalis stage.
wrong.1: The egg is the starting point, way before the butterfly.
wrong.2: Flowers are where the butterfly drinks nectar, not where it comes from.

quiz.say: Which order correctly shows the life cycle?
quiz.why: The cycle always starts with the egg, grows through the caterpillar, rests in the chrysalis, and ends as a butterfly.

wrong.0: The cycle must always begin with the egg laid by the parent.
wrong.1: The caterpillar stage happens before it makes the chrysalis.
wrong.2: The butterfly is the end result, not the start of the cycle.
